name: Furuta Ayuki
source:
Ayuki is the nurse of the school and also the best friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c21991]Aya[/url] since high school.

She is very worried about Aya whenever she gets sick from overwork.

She has heard a lot about "[url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuu-kun[/url]" from Aya as she speaks about him often.
